query_wording: Find the latest published procurement plan and summarize the main packages and planned timing.

placeholders.reason: The query needs a project; Q4 uses EASP. Its latest plan is UECCC's, and its STEP table text is column-split, which tests careful reading.

turns.user: For P166685, find the latest published procurement plan and summarize the main packages and planned timing.

expected_sources.role: Newest procurement plan by document date

expected_sources.note: The STEP table text is split by column (descriptions, then amounts, then statuses), so pairing values with packages needs care.

text: Latest published procurement plan for P166685: document dated 2026-07-01 (http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099063026212521629; STEP revised plan date 2026-06-30, original plan approved 2022-08-10). Its executing agency is the Uganda Energy Credit Capitalization Company (UECCC), i.e. it covers UECCC's parts of the project (financial intermediation and its PIU), not MEMD's grid works; recent EASP plans disclosed in 2026 are all UECCC plans (p. 3).
The textual part is the generic 2021-2022 preamble (STEP use, standard procurement documents, national procedures under the PPDA) (pp. 1-2).

Main packages (STEP tables, pp. 3-6): consulting services for the financial intermediation component - development and operationalisation of Environmental and Social Management Systems for ESCOs and for participating financial institutions; a second Independent Verification Agent contract for the off-grid solar, productive-use and clean-cooking results-based financing schemes (for the additional US$20 million allocation); impact evaluations of the financial intermediation component, of productive-use uptake and of the electrification of schools and health centres; a productive-use market analysis; training of local biomass stove manufacturers; ISO 27001 certification; and individual consultants for the UECCC PIU (project manager, risk manager, programme managers, procurement, safeguards, refugee programme coordinator). Goods and non-consulting services: an electronic document and records management system, a management information system, computers, furniture and ICT upgrades.

Timing: the consultancies added for the financial intermediation work carry planned dates in the first half of 2026 (for example the schools and health centres impact study, the PUE market analysis and the PUE uptake impact study, Consultant Qualification Selection, Open - National, US$75,000, US$50,000 and US$60,000, with planned dates from January-March 2026 and status Under Implementation, p. 4); many PIU staff contracts are already signed; several packages are pending implementation or cancelled.
Caveat: the plan's table text separates descriptions from amounts and dates, so amounts and dates should be read from the PDF (or STEP) before relying on them for any package not quoted above.

right_sources: Identifies the newest plan by document date (40114655, 2026-07-01) and that it is UECCC's plan.
grounded: Package descriptions come from the plan; any amounts, methods or dates quoted match the plan; nothing is guessed where the text cannot pair values with packages.
complete: Summarizes the main package types and gives timing information (planned dates or status) for the main packages.
scoped: Says which agency's plan it is and flags limits of reading the plan's text (or that MEMD's grid procurement is not in this plan).

notes: EASP plans are updated every few weeks; a newer plan may be the latest at run time. The reviewer should confirm the three quoted amounts against the PDF.
